function: FL-trained attention-based receive beamforming at vehicular terminals: maps sample covariance matrices to weights that null co-frequency interference from other NGSO satellites in the satellite downlink (pp. 1, 8).
system: NGSO satellite downlink at 11.5 GHz with interfering satellites; each vehicle receives with an 8x8 UPA (64 elements); LoS-only channel; no RIS (pp. 6, 11).
method: Attention-based beamformer (Conv1D plus multi-head attention) trained locally with negative-SINR loss, federated averaging at the satellite, local fine-tuning (personalization), pretrained or random initialization (pp. 8-9, 12).
data_channel: Own MATLAB satellite-toolbox orbit simulation, LoS channel (Bessel antenna gain, free-space path loss), 14 vehicles; no 3GPP model or measurements (pp. 6, 10-11).
test_conditions: FL training on 7 participating vehicles; tests on their local samples and on 7 non-participating vehicles at three unseen user distributions; one or three interferers (pp. 11, 13).
baselines: Classical MRC and ZFBF with perfect CSI (oracle bound); local-only non-federated variant of the same model; no earlier learned beamformer compared (pp. 7, 12).
metrics: Global SINR (dB) and gap to ZFBF over communication rounds; relative per-VUT training time; beam patterns (pp. 10, 14, 16).
complexity: Big-O per VUT: MRC O(M), ZFBF O(M(Ik+1)^2+(Ik+1)^3), AttBF O(M^2); FedAvg O(|K||Theta|); relative CPU training time (p. 10, Fig. 15 on p. 16).
openness: Data only promised (will be made available) on the SmartSpace project page, ref. [47] https://fnr-smartspace-project.uni.lu/datasets/; no code released (pp. 11, 19).
q1_support: p. 6: "the Non Line-of-Sight (NLoS) component can be safely ignored" Not met: own LoS-only channel model simulated with a MATLAB satellite toolbox (p. 10); no 3GPP NTN (TR 38.811) or measured channel.
q2_support: p. 13: "we evaluate the generalization capability of the proposed FedSatBF framework to unseen users that do not participate in FL training"
q3_support: p. 12: "we additionally consider a local-only baseline" Not met: this is a non-federated variant of the proposed model; MRC and ZFBF are the only other baselines, so no earlier learned beamformer is compared.
q4_support: p. 10: "asymptotic per-round computational cost (i.e., closed-form Big-O analysis) of FedSatBF"
q5_support: p. 11: "The full datasets in this article will be made available" Not met: future promise only; no dataset or code is released, and the only link is in ref. [47] (p. 19).
notes: Area 6: learned receive beamforming of a satellite link (NTN beam control) outranks area 3; FedAvg is digital over a dedicated signaling channel (p. 9), so not area 7. q1=0: own LoS simulator (p. 6, p. 10), 3GPP TR 38.821 is cited only for the 10 degree minimum elevation (p. 6). q2=1 is borderline: unseen non-participating vehicles in the same cell with the same interferers (p. 13). q3=0: only MRC, ZFBF and the non-federated local-only variant of the proposed model are compared (p. 12), no earlier learned beamformer. q4=1: Big-O table (Table 5, p. 10). q5=0: dataset release is a future promise (p. 11), not a release; the link is only in ref. [47] and the reviewer may check whether that page is live. Title and DOI on p. 1 match.
